info.title: Findme API
info.description: Compute-then-explain API: deterministic engines (Zi Wei, Bazi, almanac, numerology, astrology) behind a guest-first REST surface. Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <guest JWT>`, `X-Locale`, `Accept-Language`, `X-Tz`.

get.summary: Liveness
JSON counters (prom-client later)

post.summary: Create a guest user and return a 180-day Bearer JWT
post.description: locale/country/traditionPack/calendarStandard come from the body, else X-Locale / Accept-Language / X-Tz headers and @findme/i18n defaults.

post.summary: Link the guest to a Supabase account (501 until SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET is configured)

get.summary: Current user settings

put.summary: Update locale / tradition pack / calendar standard / tz / daily hour

delete.summary: Hard-delete the user and every owned row (profiles, readings, credits, …)

post.summary: Create a birth profile (server encrypts birth data, computes core_json + 3 insights)

get.summary: List my profiles
Get a profile (owner may request the decrypted birth input with ?includeBirth=true)

delete.summary: Delete a profile and its readings

get.summary: Zi Wei Dou Shu chart (12 palaces, localized) + horoscope for a date
Bazi: four pillars, ten gods, luck periods, annual luck
Numerology (Pythagorean): life path, name numbers, cycles
Western natal chart (planets, houses, aspects)
Public day almanac (黄历 / lịch ngày) for a national calendar standard

post.summary: Date Picker: rank days in a window for a task, avoiding clashes with the given profiles (Plus or 1 credit)

get.summary: Daily Oracle: daily_content segments for the user + personalised almanac / personal day / sky + streak

post.summary: Create a deep reading: engine runs synchronously; AI narrative streams later via /readings/:id/stream
post.description: Payment: first deep reading is free (free_first), then Plus subscription, then `payWith:"credit"` (1 credit, debited transactionally). Otherwise 402 `{reason, paywall:true}`. tarot_spread / iching return 501 until their engines land.

get.summary: My readings (newest first)
One reading
SSE: `engine_summary` → (`delta`…) → `section` × n → `done`. Narrative is composed once and cached on the reading.
get.description: Events: `engine_summary` {atomKeys, confidence}; `delta` {text} raw streamed model text (only on first composition with AI enabled); `section` {index,title,body,atomRefs}; `summary`, `actions`, `caveats`, `disclaimer`; `done` {readingId, model, usedFallbackTemplate}; `error` {message}.

post.summary: Ask the AI guide a follow-up question grounded on your core facts and (optionally) a reading
post.description: Free users get 3 questions per local day; Plus is unlimited. Answers are grounded on stored engine facts only.

get.summary: List content atoms (latest version per key+locale unless includeVersions)

post.summary: Create a new version of an atom (version = max+1)

get.summary: One atom (any status)

post.summary: Bulk upsert atoms (JSONL rows from packages/content). Upsert by id; keeps existing status unless overwriteStatus

get.summary: Atom counts per tradition × locale × status

post.summary: Run the Daily Oracle generator now for a date and locales (idempotent upsert)

get.summary: Preview generated Daily Oracle rows
Products available for web checkout (configured Stripe prices)

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a subscription or credit pack (501 when Stripe is not configured)
Stripe Customer Portal link (manage/cancel). 501 when not configured
Register an Expo/Web push token and enable daily push

delete.summary: Remove a push token (disables daily push when none remain)

get.summary: Published content atoms by key (fallback locale → en); public, CDN-cacheable
Active subscriptions, credit balance, unlocked features
